notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.
